facts.fact: Myriad says the Central Bank of the Congo authorised it on or before 20 July 2026 to operate as a payment aggregator and payment software provider, a category the BCC classes as payment ancillary service providers.
The BCC authorised the non-bank company Myriad as a payment aggregator, which it classifies as a payment ancillary service provider, separate from banks and e-money institutions.

COD.note: No law or rule is named.
